opportunities.title: PDF libro para impresión y digital
opportunities.description: Entrego todos los textos e imágenes ya maquetados y necesito convertir ese material en un paquete de PDFs profesionales. Busco a alguien que domine Adobe InDesign, Acrobat Pro (o herramientas equivalentes) y los estándares de pre-prensa para generar archivos impecables tanto en papel como en pantalla. Requiero una revisión rápida conmigo para confirmar detalles finales (portada, paginación, créditos) antes de la exportación definitiva. Entrega los tres PDFs junto con el reporte de preflight y las configuraciones empleadas, para que pueda reimprimir o actualizar futuras ediciones sin contratiempos.

opportunities.title: Academia Online para Oposiciones Policía Nacional
opportunities.description: Busco freelance para crear academia online de oposiciones a Policía Nacional Busco un profesional freelance con experiencia en WordPress y Moodle para desarrollar una academia online de preparación de oposiciones a Policía Nacional. Objetivo: disponer de una plataforma profesional, preparada para vender cursos online, gestionar alumnos y realizar exámenes tipo test, que yo pueda administrar posteriormente sin conocimientos avanzados de programación. Funcionalidades necesarias - Diseño profesional de la web con WordPress y dominio propio. - Instalación y configuración del aula virtual Moodle. - Organización de los cursos por temas y bloques del temario. - Sistema de preguntas tipo test, banco de preguntas, simulacros de examen, corrección automática y resultados. - Registro de alumnos y área privada. - Integración de una pasarela de pago con tarjeta. - Automatización de las matrículas: tras confirmar el pago, el alumno debe obtener acceso al curso correspondiente. - Diseño adaptable a móviles y tabletas. - Configuración de seguridad, copias de seguridad y correo electrónico. - Formación para aprender a gestionar alumnos, subir temario, importar preguntas y crear nuevos test. Requisitos del profesional Busco a alguien con experiencia demostrable en WordPress, Moodle, WooCommerce y pasarelas de pago. Valoraré propuestas alternativas, como utilizar un LMS integrado en WordPress en lugar de Moodle, siempre que permitan realizar test avanzados y gestionar los alumnos y pagos correctamente. Presupuesto y condiciones Solicito un presupuesto cerrado y desglosado que incluya: - Desarrollo e instalación. - Plugins y licencias necesarias. - Costes recurrentes de hosting y mantenimiento. - Plazo de entrega. - Soporte posterior y posibles costes adicionales. La plataforma, el dominio y las cuentas deberán quedar a mi nombre, con acceso de administrador. Quiero poder gestionar la academia por mi cuenta una vez finalizado el proyecto. No es necesario cargar todo el temario ni miles de preguntas inicialmente; esa parte podré realizarla yo. Por favor, adjuntad ejemplos de proyectos similares y explicad brevemente cómo resolveríais la integración de pagos y matrículas automáticas.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40783785, publicado hace 2 días). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 750 - 1,500.

Objetivo: disponer de una plataforma profesional, preparada para vender cursos online, gestionar alumnos y realizar exámenes tipo test, que yo pueda administrar posteriormente sin conocimientos avanzados de programación. Funcionalidades necesarias - Diseño profesional de la web con WordPress y dominio propio. - Instalación y configuración del aula virtual Moodle. - Organización de los cursos por temas y bloques del temario. - Sistema de preguntas tipo test, banco de preguntas, simulacros de examen, corrección automática y resultados. - Registro de alumnos y área privada. - Integración de una pasarela de pago con tarjeta. - Automatización de las matrículas: tras confirmar el pago, el alumno debe obtener acceso al curso correspondiente. - Diseño adaptable a móviles y tabletas. - Configuración de seguridad, copias de seguridad y correo electrónico. - Formación para aprender a gestionar alumnos, subir temario, importar preguntas y crear nuevos test. Requisitos del profesional Busco a alguien con experiencia demostrable en WordPress, Moodle, WooCommerce y pasarelas de pago. Valoraré propuestas alternativas, como utilizar un LMS integrado en WordPress en lugar de Moodle, siempre que permitan realizar test avanzados y gestionar los alumnos y pagos correctamente. Presupuesto y condiciones Solicito un presupuesto cerrado y desglosado que incluya: - Desarrollo e instalación. - Plugins y licencias necesarias. - Costes recurrentes de hosting y mantenimiento. - Plazo de entrega. - Soporte posterior y posibles costes adicionales. La plataforma, el dominio y las cuentas deberán quedar a mi nombre, con acceso de administrador. Quiero poder gestionar la academia por mi cuenta una vez finalizado el proyecto. No es necesario cargar todo el temario ni miles de preguntas inicialmente; esa parte podré realizarla yo. Por favor, adjuntad ejemplos de proyectos similares y explicad brevemente cómo resolveríais la integración de pagos y matrículas automáticas."

proposal.body:
¡Hola MUNICIPIO DE PALERMO HUILA (Palermo)! 👋 Un cordial saludo desde San Agustín, Huila.

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con control de calidad avalado por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **🏛️ [Circular D-416-2026] MUNICIPIO DE PALERMO HUILA (Palermo) — D-416-2026**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado, café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🎋🔩 **3. Infraestructura Cafetera**: También construimos y remodelamos **secaderos solares/parabólicos y cubiertas en guadua y metal**.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?

proposal.subject: Suministro Directo de Café Especial Borbón Rosado (Tostado, Molido a Medida y Lotes) — Origen San Agustín, Huila
proposal.body:
¡Hola EMPUGIGANTE S.A. E.S.P. (Gigante)! 👋 Un cordial saludo desde San Agustín, Huila.

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con control de calidad avalado por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **🏛️ [Circular CTOPSA-160-2025] EMPUGIGANTE S.A. E.S.P. (Gigante) — PRESTACION DE SERVICIOS DE APOYO A LA GESTION; DE FORMA AUTONOMA E INDEPEND**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado, café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🎋🔩 **3. Infraestructura Cafetera**: También construimos y remodelamos **secaderos solares/parabólicos y cubiertas en guadua y metal**.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?
proposal.turnaround: Despacho inmediato de muestras y pedidos desde San Agustín, Huila

proposal.subject: Suministro Directo de Café Especial Borbón Rosado (Tostado, Molido a Medida y Lotes) — Origen San Agustín, Huila
proposal.body:
¡Hola MUNICIPIO DE NEIVA (Neiva)! 👋 Un cordial saludo desde San Agustín, Huila.

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con control de calidad avalado por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **🏛️ [Circular MNSGCDPS-1487-2025] MUNICIPIO DE NEIVA (Neiva) — Contrato de Prestación de Servicios Profesionales**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado, café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🎋🔩 **3. Infraestructura Cafetera**: También construimos y remodelamos **secaderos solares/parabólicos y cubiertas en guadua y metal**.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?
proposal.turnaround: Despacho inmediato de muestras y pedidos desde San Agustín, Huila

opportunities.title: USA HVAC & Plumbing Drafting
opportunities.description: I handle a steady flow of HVAC and plumbing design work for projects across the United States and I’m looking for a mechanical engineer who can step in on an ongoing basis. The core need is straightforward: produce complete, code-compliant design drawings and plans that I can issue to architects, contractors, and permitting officials without extra rework. Typical tasks will include laying out ductwork and pipe runs, selecting equipment, annotating schedules, and making sure every sheet aligns with relevant U.S. standards (IMC, IPC, ASHRAE, local amendments, etc.). I usually mark up a background or share a Revit/AutoCAD model and expect you to turn that into polished construction documents—title blocks, legends, and all. Because the workload fluctuates, I’d like someone comfortable picking up a small set one week and a full package the next, always meeting the agreed turnaround. If you have a solid portfolio of HVAC and plumbing projects and are confident working independently while staying responsive over email or Teams, let’s discuss the first assignment and see how we fit.

opportunities.title: Bi-Directional Xero & Odoo Sync
opportunities.description: Bi-Directional Xero & Odoo Sync Build a two-way Odoo Online and Xero integration matching our ServiceM8 accounting sync We are United Barrel Services in Australia. We are replacing ServiceM8 with an existing customised Odoo Online system and keeping Xero for accounting. Please quote an external integration using n8n Cloud or another supported API service. We must stay on Odoo Online; no installable backend module or Odoo.sh migration. Please read the attached accounting-data brief before quoting. No forms, reports, PDFs, file attachments or photos are to be sent to Xero. No Google storage work is required. CURRENT SETUP Our ServiceM8 account connects to the Xero organisation Pro Barrel Services. Invoices export as Approved, use the job number, and partial invoices use A/B/C suffixes. Prices are tax exclusive. The default terms are 30 Days, with customer-specific terms/due dates to preserve. Payments use the configured PRO BARREL SERVICES PTY LTD account. Xero Tracking Categories, Partial/Progress Invoicing and Bundles are enabled. There are ten Region choices and six tax definitions detailed in the attachment. CURRENT DOCUMENTED TIMING - Invoice export begins on approval. Total-changing edits can resync invoice lines. - New ServiceM8 customers/items first export with an approved invoice. Linked customer/item updates sync both ways within approximately 30 minutes. - Payments entered before approval accompany the invoice; later receipts export immediately. Payments on linked invoices in Xero return within 30 minutes. - Tax definitions and Sales/Revenue account codes import automatically from Xero; exact ongoing intervals are not published. - Tracking definitions refresh daily, taking up to 24 hours. Region selections travel with invoice export. - Xero-origin invoices do not import into ServiceM8. This is not full two-way general ledger synchronisation. These are ServiceM8 published timings, not measured latency in our account. Full sources and lifecycle rules are in the attachment. REQUIRED WORK 1. Two-way customers and catalogue items, with stable Xero IDs, field ownership and conflict handling. 2. Office-approved Odoo invoices to Xero, with correct GST/TaxType, accounts, dates, PO, descriptions and Region on invoice lines. 3. Partial invoices from one job, unique numbers, correct charge allocations, independent balances and bundle component handling. 4. Recorded payments both ways, without duplicates or feedback loops; return part-paid/paid/balance state and handle Xero reversals/credits affecting the balance. State whether you implement native Odoo reconciliation or a separate Xero balance display. 5. Visible sync status/errors, safe retry, durable queue/ID mappings, rate-limit handling, daily reconciliation and catch-up after outages or quota exhaustion. 6. Match existing ServiceM8-era records before cutover, preserve historical invoice identities and prevent re-export. TARGET TIMING Start approved invoice/receipt export immediately, proposed normal completion within 60 seconds. Return linked customer/item/payment changes within 30 minutes, 24/7. Refresh tracking daily. Proposed tax/account refresh: within 30 minutes. Disclose limitations and any changes needed to meet these targets. ODOO Existing jobs use planning.slot; invoices use account.move/account.move.line; job charges use x_job_price_line. Studio custom fields and internal split billing already exist. Confirm Odoo 20/current JSON-2 API compatibility and the required access. Reuse our existing workflow rather than rebuild it. QUOTE AND DELIVERABLES Provide a fixed/capped AUD price, GST status, milestones, timeline, platform/hosting costs, warranty and ongoing support. Separate discovery, Studio changes, cutover/history work, and any conditional stock-visibility allowance. We are considering 2,500 n8n executions/month: show an execution budget from measured volumes and recommend the correct plan without slowing the required sync. Include exported workflows/source, field mappings, configuration, successful test evidence, administrator training and a recovery/key-renewal runbook. All accounts/workflows must be owned by us. Demonstrate normal, partial, reversed and duplicate payments/invoices, invoice edits, mapped taxes/regions, outages and safe retries before authorised production rollout. Please provide examples of similar Odoo Online/Xero work, describe your proposed architecture, identify what remains manual and list all exclusions.

opportunities.title: Asterisk-Zoiper AWS Configuration
opportunities.description: Necesito que Asterisk quede funcionando en un servidor Amazon Web Services y que Zoiper en Android se registre sin problemas. El escenario es sencillo pero debe quedar completamente operativo: • Tipo de llamadas: entrantes y salientes usando números telefónicos reales. • Extensiones simultáneas: entre 1 y 5 en Zoiper para Android. • Proveedor de telefonía: ya dispongo de los números, pero aún no cuento con los datos de conexión; por eso requiero tu ayuda para seleccionar o configurar correctamente el troncal (SIP o IAX) que garantice buena calidad y tarifas competitivas. Al finalizar espero: 1. Instancia AWS debidamente asegurada (puertos, firewall, NAT) con Asterisk actualizado y estable. 2. Dialplan configurado para llamadas entrantes y salientes, grabación opcional y buzón de voz básico. 3. Creación de las extensiones, credenciales y QR de aprovisionamiento para Zoiper en Android. 4. Configuración del troncal con el proveedor elegido, pruebas de llamada y registro de calidad. 5. Breve guía en español con los pasos esenciales por si necesito añadir más usuarios o cambiar números. Con todo listo, podremos marcar y recibir desde los móviles de inmediato.

opportunities.title: Custom 3D-Printed Dr. Doom Cosplay
opportunities.description: I am seeking a skilled 3D designer and fabricator to create a fully functional Doctor Doom cosplay outfit. The outfit should include full armor, a mask, gloves, boots, and a cape. It will be used for cosplay events, conventions, photoshoots, video content, and display purposes. I need it completed before December 17th. I plan to wear it to the movie premiere of Marvel's DOOMSDAY. **Ideal Skills and Experience:** - Expertise in 3D design and 3D printing - Experience in creating wearable costumes and cosplay outfits - Ability to work with different materials to achieve the desired look and functionality - Attention to detail and commitment to quality craftsmanship Please provide examples of relevant previous work in your application. I've uploaded images of general idea for customization. I've also purchased the new SWA Latverian-Saber crossover to tether a weapon of worthy proportions to outfit. Once selected for development, I have alterations in mind to crossover other fantasy sources Id love to include in the personalized DOOM fit. I would love collaboration to start development of my own 3d cosplay designing production as I've been developing a 3-D printing company and working way out to cosplay outfits. However, for this fit, I want it to be done professionally as DR DOOM is one of my ultimate favorites AND DOOMSDAY is quickly approaching. I'd love the challenge of developing this myself, and i would be remiss to loose the opportunity to go to the movie premiere of the ultimate cinematic experience of a lifetime dressed as the ultimate adversary!

opportunities.title: Editor de Video para Reel de Marca Personal con Estilo Cinematográfico
opportunities.description: Se busca un editor de video talentoso para crear un reel de marca personal impactante, utilizando material ya grabado. El proyecto requiere una edición narrativa, profesional y natural, con una estética cinematográfica ligera que transmita el mensaje del cliente de manera auténtica. El cliente proporcionará la grabación principal (hablando a cámara) y varios clips de apoyo del día a día para complementar visualmente la historia. Se espera que el editor tenga un criterio sólido para la selección de clips, la construcción del ritmo y la capacidad de transmitir la esencia del mensaje, respetando la forma de hablar del cliente. Se compartirán ejemplos visuales de referencia (como el contenido de Leo Tafoya). El trabajo incluye: - Selección de las mejores tomas y ajuste de cortes, pausas y ritmo para una narrativa fluida. - Combinación de momentos a cámara con clips de apoyo, manteniendo la voz del cliente como hilo conductor. - Limpieza y mejora del audio: reducción de ruido y equilibrio de volumen de la voz. - Selección de música de fondo con licencia adecuada para redes sociales e incorporación de efectos de sonido sutiles. - Corrección de color e iluminación para asegurar una consistencia visual y una estética cinematográfica. - Adición de subtítulos legibles, con un diseño limpio y énfasis puntual en palabras clave. Entregables: - Video vertical en formato 9:16, resolución 1080 × 1920, archivo MP4 listo para publicar. - Una versión del video con subtítulos y otra sin subtítulos. - Dos rondas de ajustes sobre la primera propuesta de edición. Este es un proyecto inicial, con potencial para futuras colaboraciones si el resultado es satisfactorio. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Crear o editar video ¿Qué necesitas?: Video nuevo a partir de grabaciones existentes

opportunities.title: Social Media Chat Support Assistant
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk membalas chat pelanggan secara cepat dan sopan di akun Instagram dan Facebook bisnis kami. Fokus utama adalah: • Menjawab pertanyaan seputar produk atau layanan. • Menangani keluhan dan permintaan bantuan dengan solusi ramah serta mencatat kasus yang perlu ditindaklanjuti. • (Opsional) Jika ada pesan WhatsApp masuk, cukup tangani dua kategori di atas saja—pesanan dan pembayaran sudah ditangani tim lain. Saya akan menyediakan panduan jawaban, FAQ, dan akses admin ke inbox. Tugas harian meliputi memantau DM, menyapa pelanggan dalam 5 menit pertama, memperbarui spreadsheet status percakapan, serta menandai chat yang perlu di‐escalate. Kualifikasi yang saya butuhkan: • Terbiasa menggunakan Meta Business Suite atau Creator Studio. • Bahasa Indonesia baku dan ramah; dasar Bahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. • Teliti, responsif, dan mampu bekerja fleksibel (jam puncak 09.00-17.00 WIB). Hasil kerja dianggap selesai bila setiap pesan pada hari yang sama sudah dijawab, laporan singkat akhir hari dikirim, dan tingkat kepuasan pelanggan dipertahankan minimal 90 %.

opportunities.title: Windows Desktop Software Development & Software License Management
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced software developer to build a private Windows desktop application that combines workflow automation with a secure software license management system. ## KEY REQUIREMENTS - Modern Windows desktop application with a user-friendly interface. - Secure license management, including 30-day validity, offline verification, activation, expiration handling, and device limits. - Backend API and database for user and license management. - Workflow automation with task monitoring, error handling, retries, and recovery. - Separate owner/admin controls and a simplified user interface. - Secure, modular, maintainable, and well-tested software. - Complete source code, documentation, and deployment instructions. # REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS - **C# / .NET Desktop Development** or an appropriate alternative. - **WPF and MVVM Architecture** - **Software Architecture and Modular Design** - **REST API / Backend Development** - **Database Design and Integration** - **Software Licensing and License Validation** - **Authentication and Application Security** - **Workflow Automation and State Management** - **Asynchronous Programming and Concurrency** - **Error Handling, Retry Logic, and Recovery** - **Unit Testing and Integration Testing** - **Git and Source Code Management** # REQUIRED EXPERIENCE - Proven experience developing and delivering Windows desktop applications. - Practical experience implementing software licensing, activation, expiration, and offline license verification. - Experience building backend APIs and integrating databases. - Experience designing reliable automation workflows with session/task management. - Strong understanding of security, failure recovery, testing, and maintainable code. - Ability to evaluate technical requirements, identify risks, and justify architectural decisions. The final deliverables must include the working software, complete source code, documentation, and deployment instructions. This project is aimed at attracting experienced developers who can deliver a reliable solution within the agreed scope.

opportunities.title: EXPERT WINDOWS SOFTWARE DEVELOPER — AUTOMATION & LICENSE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced software developer to build a private Windows desktop application that combines workflow automation with a secure software license management system. ## KEY REQUIREMENTS - Modern Windows desktop application with a user-friendly interface. - Secure license management, including 1/3/5/7/30-day validity, offline verification, activation, expiration, and device limits. - Backend API and database for user and license management. - Workflow automation with task monitoring, error handling, retries, and recovery. - Separate owner/admin controls and a simplified user interface. - Secure, modular, maintainable, and well-tested software. - Complete source code, documentation, and deployment instructions. # REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS - **C# / .NET Desktop Development** - **WPF and MVVM Architecture** - **Software Architecture and Modular Design** - **REST API / Backend Development** - **Database Design and Integration** - **Software Licensing and License Validation** - **Authentication and Application Security** - **Workflow Automation and State Management** - **Asynchronous Programming and Concurrency** - **Error Handling, Retry Logic, and Recovery** - **Unit Testing and Integration Testing** - **Git and Source Code Management** # REQUIRED EXPERIENCE - Proven experience developing and delivering Windows desktop applications. - Practical experience implementing software licensing, activation, expiration, and offline license verification. - Experience building backend APIs and integrating databases. - Experience designing reliable automation workflows with session/task management. - Strong understanding of security, failure recovery, testing, and maintainable code. - Ability to evaluate technical requirements, identify risks, and justify architectural decisions. - Experience delivering complete projects with source code, documentation, and deployment instructions.

opportunities.title: UK & EU B2B Sales Executive for HR Consulting Services Needed -- 2
opportunities.description: I need to boost sales of my HR consulting services across the UK and Europe by filling the pipeline with decision-makers who already recognise they have an HR pain point, are open to talking solutions and signing a contract with my company. The target niches are companies from Technology, Finance, Banking, Construction and Building, Manufacturing and FMCG. Anything outside those niches is out of scope for now. Only warm and hot leads are of interest, people who have engaged in communications with you and our content, asked for information, and shown clear needs and buying intent. Cold scraping is not useful to this project and will not be accepted. You may use email outreach and social media to identify, engage and nurture prospects, including LinkedIn, relevant Facebook business groups, professional communities, specialist forums and other appropriate channels. Telephone follow-up is optional. Internet-based calls (e.g., WhatsApp, Zoom or Microsoft Teams) are recommended where appropriate to engage prospects and progress sales opportunities. Qualified discovery calls with prospective clients and regular meetings with me to review leads, discuss client needs and progress sales opportunities are mandatory. The objective is to convert qualified prospects into paying clients, with me involved in discovery and sales discussions as appropriate. Feel free to suggest repurposing existing social marketing content, create snappy outreach copy, and suggest funnel tweaks that improve conversion. Your Background - Proven B2B sales experience in the UK and EU markets in the following sectors: Technology, Finance, Banking, Construction and Building, Manufacturing and FMCG. - Experience generating leads, prospecting, and engaging decision-makers. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, and ability to build relationships with business owners, CEOs, Managing Directors, and HR leaders. - Self-motivated, organised, and able to work independently and as part of our team, delivering measurable results. Deliverables - You must maintain an accurate, up-to-date shared sales tracker (i.e. spreadsheet, CRM) documenting all communications with prospects. This should include the prospect’s details (names, title), date and channel of contact, company name, direct personal email, phone, LinkedIn URL, country, industry tag, and a brief interaction note that justifies the “warm” or “hot” label once you have qualified them. - Screenshots and PDFs of outreach where appropriate, responses received, follow-up actions, meeting outcomes and next steps are required. This evidence serves for weekly progress reviews and to verify the work you completed against the agreed KPIs. - Minimum weekly batch uploads of 40 prospects matching the target customer profile to track progress and refine targeting quickly (delivered on Friday for next week). - 40 personalised outreach messages per week, sent through approved communication channels, with appropriate follow-ups to earlier prospects. - At least 4 introductory meetings or discovery calls with new prospects, and minimum 2 follow-up meetings scheduled weekly are mandatory. Quality over raw volume will be the performance benchmark. Key Objective The key objective of the project is to generate warm/hot leads and convert qualified prospects into paying clients with signed contracts for services with our business. Timeline This project will run for 4 (four) weeks. Compensation Compensation includes: - A fixed project fee of £200, - Plus 15% commission on every contract you successfully close. The fixed fee will be divided into four weekly milestones of £50 each. Each milestone will be payable upon submission and acceptance of the agreed weekly deliverables, accurate tracking and evidence of completed activity. From week two, qualified sales meetings will also be a key performance target. The success commission will be 15% of net service fees actually received from new clients directly sourced and introduced by you, excluding VAT, refunds and reimbursed expenses. Acceptance Criteria 1. All clients operate within the UK or Europe and fall into Technology, Finance, Banking, Construction and Building, Manufacturing and FMCG verticals. 2. The bounce rate for supplied prospects must remain below 5 %. Duplicate, invalid or incorrectly targeted contacts will not count towards the weekly prospect target and must be replaced at no additional cost. 3. Every lead must show a verifiable engagement trail and a genuine interest to become a client shortly, within 2 weeks (opened email communication, replies on LinkedIn and other approved platforms, requests for calls and meetings, etc.). You will need to provide evidence of your communications with prospects in the sales tracker. If you have a proven record of B2B sales for professional services and you are comfortable owning both outreach and direct sales to decision-makers, get in touch. Submit your bid and let us discuss how you can help grow our client base.

opportunities.title: Amazon Flex Offer Alert System
opportunities.description: I need a small web-based application that signs in to my Amazon Flex account, continuously checks for new delivery blocks and instantly forwards any matching offer to me through Telegram. The core flow is straightforward: log in, poll the offers endpoint, apply simple filters I can change in a browser (station, start time, pay, duration), then push a formatted Telegram message with all the details and a one-tap link or button to accept the block. The web interface should also mirror the feed in real time so I can review everything from a desktop or phone browser when Telegram is not convenient. Please build with whatever stack you are most comfortable with, so long as: • The back-end can keep the Amazon session alive and handle 2-step verification when it appears. • Notifications over the Telegram Bot API arrive in less than a second after an offer is detected. • All credentials and filters are stored securely (env variables or encrypted DB field is fine). • The solution is ready for basic deployment on a cheap VPS (Docker image or clear setup script). I’d like the working MVP—web app plus Telegram bot—delivered within a month. Let me know which libraries or services you plan to use for the Amazon calls and how you will stay within Amazon’s terms while maintaining reliability.

opportunities.title: Amazon Flex Offer
opportunities.description: I need a real-time system that logs in through Amazon’s ap/signin and maplanding flow (assuming it is still technically possible and allowed) and polls the internal endpoints that surface Whole Foods Instant Offers. The service must run 24/7, watch every offer as it appears, and respect user-defined filters for location, payout, distance, and duration before surfacing anything. Once an offer clears those filters it should show up instantly on a lightweight dashboard and also reach me through both a small companion app and a Telegram bot. I do not need automatic acceptance; simply seeing the offers fast and reliably is enough. Please build this with clean, well-documented code and include a one-step deployment script or detailed setup notes so I can run it on my own server. A live screen-share demo that captures actual Instant Offers in real time is the final acceptance gate before releasing payment. You must already have hands-on Amazon Flex API experience—ideally you have built or currently run an Instant Offers bot—and be comfortable proving that expertise. In your reply let me know: • Previous, directly relevant projects (links or screenshots welcome) • The tech stack you plan to use (Python, Node.js, Selenium, Playwright, etc.) • Estimated timeline with major milestones • Your fixed price for the entire job, including the demo and hand-off of full source code I am ready to hire quickly once I see credible evidence that you have cracked the Amazon Flex authentication and offer feed before.

opportunities.title: Mobile Game Visual Modding
opportunities.description: I have a completed mobile game and want to breathe new life into it through visual upgrades. The core gameplay stays the same; what I need is a developer who can dive into the existing project files, locate the pre-made functions that handle visual assets, and modify them so we can introduce sharper character models, fresh skins, and smoother animations. The project involves: • Reworking or extending the current code that drives character rendering, particle effects, and animation controllers. • Importing updated 2D/3D assets (I’ll supply source files) and wiring them into the build without breaking live gameplay. • Optimising any new textures or animation sheets for solid frame rates on both Android and iOS. Everything is already organised in Git, and the game is built with Unity, so you’ll need proven Unity experience plus comfort with C# scripting, Animator Controller tweaks, and asset-bundle management. If you’ve modded commercial APKs before or handled reverse-engineering tasks such as editing DLLs or Smali, that’s a strong bonus. Acceptance criteria • Latest test build installs and runs on mid-tier devices with equal or better performance than the current live version. • All new character skins appear in-game, selection menus update correctly, and animations trigger exactly as in the spec sheet. • No crashes, null-ref errors, or shader glitches reported over a 20-minute continuous playtest. Share a short note about similar visual modding work you’ve shipped, along with a link or build if possible, and let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Blender/Houdini Fire & Explosion VFX
opportunities.description: I’m creating a live-action cinematic shot that calls for big, believable pyrotechnics within a $2/hour budget. The sequence features several elements: towering fireballs that roll into thick smoke plumes, controlled flames engulfing a vehicle and a portion of building façade, plus secondary details like sparks, drifting embers, and debris bursts. Real-world scale, convincing pressure, and natural dissipation are critical because the effects will sit right next to practical plates. You’re free to work in either Blender Mantaflow or Houdini Pyro/Sparse Pyro. As long as the caches and node networks are cleanly organised, parameterised, and clearly labelled, I can take it from there. Deliverables: • Editable simulation file (.blend or .hip) with all caches linked or packed • Quick playblast or OpenGL preview for timing reference The deadline is 30 days from now. Let’s collaborate to make this cinematic shot shine.

We need a friendly person with clear English to leave short voicemails for UK businesses after they close. The job: - Monday to Friday, 8pm to 11pm South Africa time (about 15 hours a week) - Use our website dialler on your laptop with a headset - When you hear the beep, read a short 20-second message, then click a button - No selling and no hard calls Pay: USD 8 to 12 an hour, plus a bonus when a business calls back. 2-week paid trial first, then ongoing work. You need: - Clear English that UK people find easy to understand - Laptop, USB headset, quiet room and good internet - Call centre or phone work is a plus How to apply (we only read applications with a voice note): 1. Record yourself reading this message (Vocaroo or WhatsApp voice note link), then say 30 seconds about you: "Hi, it's [your name] from Klyp, for Smith Law. I called after hours and got your voicemail - and that's where new clients hang up and ring the next firm. Klyp gives you an AI receptionist that learns your firm, answers their questions and books them in, day or night. Try it free - pay nothing until you're happy. klyp.co.uk - K-L-Y-P. Again, klyp.co.uk. Thanks." 2. Tell us your city, your evening hours and your hourly rate.

opportunities.title: Family-Friendly Supermarket Design
opportunities.description: I’m ready to commission a full concept design for a bright, family-friendly supermarket that features two signature attractions: • A fresh bakery and coffee counter that feels welcoming from the moment shoppers step inside. • A vibrant juice, smoothie, and salad bar that showcases healthy options and effortless grab-and-go service. The heart of the project is these food stations, so I need layouts, material selections, lighting ideas, and visual merchandising concepts that make them the stars of the floor. There’s also an outdoor patio connected to this zone, and I’d like the flow between indoor and outdoor seating to feel seamless and inviting. Beyond those focal points, bring the entire space together with a cohesive color palette, intuitive customer circulation, family-friendly signage, and fixtures that fit a modern grocery footprint. High-level tasks include: • Preliminary mood boards and color studies • Scaled floor plan with clear traffic flow • 3D renders (interior + patio) highlighting the bakery, coffee, juice, and salad stations • A short fixture, lighting, and materials schedule for each key zone I will provide building dimensions, equipment specs, and branding guidelines once we start. Please outline your approach, timeline, and the software you’ll use (SketchUp, Revit, AutoCAD, or comparable). Final files should be delivered in editable format along with high-resolution render images. Looking forward to seeing how you’ll turn this concept into an engaging, family-oriented shopping experience.

El enfoque debe ser 100 % comercial: colores y composición que llamen la atención, mensaje claro y una llamada a la acción que motive al público a comprar de inmediato. Trabajo con tamaños estándar tanto para impresión como para publicación en redes, así que el arte debe poder ajustarse fácil a ambos formatos. Prefiero un archivo PSD totalmente editable, con todas las capas bien organizadas y tipografías incrustadas o indicadas. Entregarás: • PSD editable en alta resolución • Versión lista para imprimir (PDF o JPG 300 dpi) • Versión optimizada para redes (PNG/JPG 1080 px) Al postular, envíame una propuesta detallada: explica tu enfoque creativo, tiempos estimados y, si puedes, incluye ejemplos de flyers anteriores orientados a ventas.

opportunities.title: Posicionamiento SEO Web Semana Santa
opportunities.description: Quiero mejorar la visibilidad de mi portal de noticias dedicado a la Semana Santa en toda la provincia. Mi prioridad es aparecer en los resultados de Google cuando la gente busque información sobre la Semana Santa provincial, no solo en la capital sino en cada municipio donde se celebran procesiones y actos relacionados. El sitio (Wordpress) ya publica —y seguirá publicando— principalmente: • Noticias y actualidad de hermandades y procesiones • Horarios, itinerarios y mapas de recorridos Busco una estrategia SEO integral que incluya: 1. Auditoría técnica del sitio para detectar y corregir problemas que limiten el rastreo o la velocidad. 2. Investigación de palabras clave específicas de Semana Santa, segmentadas por municipio y por tipo de búsqueda (noticias, horarios, recorrido). 3. Optimización on-page: meta-titles, descripciones, encabezados, enlazado interno y datos estructurados para eventos. 4. Plan de contenidos evergreen y de temporada que complemente mis artículos actuales y refuerce la autoridad temática. 5. Estrategia de enlaces de calidad desde portales locales, blogs cofrades y medios religiosos. 6. Reportes mensuales con métricas clave: posiciones, clics, impresiones y oportunidades de mejora. Valoraré experiencia previa posicionando medios locales o páginas sobre fiestas religiosas, así como el dominio de herramientas como Google Search Console, Ahrefs o Semrush. Mi meta es notar avances tangibles antes de la próxima Cuaresma, con tráfico creciente y presencia estable durante todo el año.

opportunities.title: Diseño integral libro de fantasía
opportunities.description: Estoy preparando el tercer volumen de una saga épica y necesito un artista que se ocupe de todo el apartado visual del libro. Los dos primeros fueron publicados por una editorial (Atlantis Ediciones) que ha quebrado y he recuperado los derechos de autor. Para los tres tomos necesito: • Portada completa (frontal, lomo y contraportada) lista para impresión y versión e-book, reflejando un estilo mágico y detallado. Relación visual entre los tres libros y una evolución oscura. • 3 Mapas de mi mundo. Los tengo hechos "de mala manera". Puedo facilitarlos para que sirvan de punto de partida. debe leerse bien tanto a página completa como en blanco y negro: Mundo completo, Un archipiélago de islas y una isla en concreto. • Pequeños diseños interiores: encabezados de capítulo, viñetas, separadores y algún motivo decorativo que mantenga la coherencia estética con la portada y el mapa. Busco ilustraciones ricas en texturas y luces, con atención al detalle y a la atmósfera fantástica. Aporto sinopsis, referencias visuales y bocetos de la geografía para facilitar el trabajo. Entregables deseados: – Arte final en alta resolución (300 dpi) en PSD/AI con capas organizadas y PDF listo para imprenta. – Archivos optimizados para Kindle/EPUB. – Versiones en escala de grises para impresión económica. Flujo propuesto: bocetos iniciales, una ronda de ajustes mayores y pulido final. Si la colaboración funciona, contaré contigo para posibles ediciones especiales y, ojalá, para el cuarto y quinto volumen. ¡Espero tu propuesta y muestras de trabajos similares!

opportunities.title: AI Payroll Data Validation Automation
opportunities.description: Every month we upload thousands of payroll lines from Excel/CSV files, direct HR software exports and the occasional online form or email attachment. Right now a team member opens each file, spots obvious issues, runs manual look-ups against the previous period and then applies every client-specific rule before anything even hits our payroll engine. I want that entire front-end check replaced by an AI layer so the team can spend their time on advisory conversations instead of mechanical validation. Scope First task is to design, build and deploy an automated checking service that plugs into our existing third-party payroll platform. The service must: • Flag missing, invalid or duplicate employee records in real time • Compare current data with the prior payroll to surface unusual spikes or drops in pay elements • Apply each client’s bespoke rules (hours caps, allowance limits, cost-centre logic, etc.) and highlight exceptions before the run proceeds Ideal flow: data lands in a monitored folder or API, the AI engine scores each row, produces an exception report and feeds a clean file straight into our payroll software. A simple dashboard or email summary showing pass/fail statistics will let the processor decide whether to move forward or investigate. Deliverables 1. Current-state process map and tech stack review 2. Working AI validation engine (code, model and configuration files) connected to our test payroll environment 3. Exception reporting interface plus user guide 4. Deployment playbook so we can roll the solution to additional clients Acceptance criteria will be sign-off of a pilot pay run where the engine catches ≥95 % of historically logged errors with <2 % false positives. You are free to choose the most suitable tooling—Python, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, RPA bots, or low-code AI services—as long as it can be maintained by our in-house IT team afterwards.

opportunities.title: Modern Wholesale Shop Logo -- 2
opportunities.description: I need a fresh, professional logo for my wholesale store, 24/7 SUPPLIERS. The design must pop on a large outdoor shop sign, so the store name has to dominate at first glance. Please render “24/7 SUPPLIERS” in bold lettering that balances blue and orange equally, then add the tagline “WHOLESALE • MAIZE FLOUR • SUGAR • COOKING OIL • PAMPERS” beneath it. A clean, modern shopping-cart icon should sit alongside the text, visibly carrying simplified graphics of flour, sugar, oil and pampers to reinforce what we sell. Keep everything on a white background for maximum legibility from a distance. Deliverables • Three distinct logo concepts for initial review • Once I choose one, supply final assets: transparent PNG, high-res JPG, and the editable AI or PSD source file I’ll release the milestone payment after I approve the final files. Let me know your turnaround time and any questions you have so we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: AI Influencer Creation/Monetization System Architect
opportunities.description: David is an independent content creator focusing on self development and life coaching. I want to sell digital information products in the self-development market using an AI influencer to deliver daily content across Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms. I’m looking for an architect to facilitate a fully monetized framework including conversion of raw content such as notes, text, and Powerpoint presentations into initial digital products, create 3 ai generated influencers for market testing/launch, and streamline/automate content creation, iteration, and deployment. Core components of this engagement are up front/one off deliverables. Other areas will be ongoing in nature. Capability to deliver future scope of work focused around automation of content creation and deployment is required for selection for the front end deliverable. The accepted search range is $40-$90 per hour. The daily workflow should create short video clips that link to longer-form content. opportunities.title: Stylized 3D Character Modeling
opportunities.description: I’m producing a short animated film and need a single, appealing studio-Ghibli-style character fully modeled and textured. Think stylised proportions rather than realism—something with clear shapes and personality that will read well on screen. Scope • Modelling only: I’ll take care of the rigging and animation myself, so your focus is clean geometry, good edge flow and UVs. • Topology must be deformation-ready (quads, no stray ngons) and organised into logical mesh groups (body, eyes, accessories). • Include UV-unwrapped, non-overlapping islands and texture maps (colour, roughness/spec, normal or bump—use the workflow that suits your pipeline). • Preferred delivery formats: .blend, .fbx or .ma/.mb, plus any sculpt files if you work in ZBrush. Acceptance I’ll load the mesh, do a quick test-skin and check that limbs bend without pinching. Once everything deforms nicely and textures look clean at 1080p, the job’s done. If you have questions about style references, poly budget or shading approach, let’s talk—happy to share concept art the moment we connect.

opportunities.title: Map Herbal Healers Across Mexico
opportunities.description: I need a resourceful researcher on the ground (or with reliable local contacts) who can track down reputable herbal medicine and traditional healers operating in multiple regions of Mexico—not just the capital. The finished work should give me a clear picture of each practitioner’s basics and credibility. To keep everything consistent, please supply a spreadsheet or database containing: • Name, physical address, direct phone or WhatsApp, plus any website or social media handles • A concise description of services offered, treatment style, and languages in which they consult • Credentials, typical pricing, notable client reviews or testimonials • A brief note that demonstrates evidence of effectiveness—nothing exhaustive, just enough to show they are recognised locally for good results I’m looking for breadth (different states and towns) and depth (solid, verifiable data). Please indicate early on how many practitioners you expect to cover and how you will confirm the information’s accuracy. If you’ve done similar field-based or culturally sensitive research, let me know; it will help me gauge timelines and plan follow-up interviews.

opportunities.title: Flutter Instant Personal Loan Application - 25/10/2026 14:38 EDT
opportunities.description: I need a complete personal-loan mobile app built with Flutter that lets customers apply for a loan end-to-end in minutes. Core flow • User registration & instant KYC: collect the mobile number, PAN, Aadhaar and a selfie, then verify them on the spot. • Credit scoring: pull the borrower’s score in real time through CIBIL or Experian APIs and decide eligibility automatically, without manual review. • Instant disbursal: once approved, push funds straight into the customer’s bank account through a payment gateway such as Razorpay, Cashfree or PayU. • Repayment automation: set up e-NACH or UPI Autopay at the time of disbursal so EMIs are deducted every month without user action. Deliverables 1. Flutter source code for Android & iOS with clean, modular Dart. 2. Working integrations for KYC verification, credit-bureau API, chosen payment gateway and auto-debit mandate. 3. Simple backend or cloud functions to orchestrate the decision engine and keep status in sync. 4. Clear documentation and post-handover support long enough for me to upload to the stores and run initial live tests. Acceptance criteria • A new user should be able to register, clear KYC and receive a loan decision in a single session. • If approved, money reaches the linked bank account immediately, and the repayment schedule appears in-app. • Failed KYC or low score blocks disbursal and shows an explanatory message. • EMIs collected automatically on the due date, with status reflected in the app dashboard. If you have shipped similar fintech or lending products in Flutter, show me. I’m ready to move quickly once I can see you understand these integrations.

opportunities.title: Flutter Instant Personal Loan Application - 25/10/2026 14:23 EDT
opportunities.description: I need a complete personal-loan mobile app built with Flutter that lets customers apply for a loan end-to-end in minutes. Core flow • User registration & instant KYC: collect the mobile number, PAN, Aadhaar and a selfie, then verify them on the spot. • Credit scoring: pull the borrower’s score in real time through CIBIL or Experian APIs and decide eligibility automatically, without manual review. • Instant disbursal: once approved, push funds straight into the customer’s bank account through a payment gateway such as Razorpay, Cashfree or PayU. • Repayment automation: set up e-NACH or UPI Autopay at the time of disbursal so EMIs are deducted every month without user action. Deliverables 1. Flutter source code for Android & iOS with clean, modular Dart. 2. Working integrations for KYC verification, credit-bureau API, chosen payment gateway and auto-debit mandate. 3. Simple backend or cloud functions to orchestrate the decision engine and keep status in sync. 4. Clear documentation and post-handover support long enough for me to upload to the stores and run initial live tests. Acceptance criteria • A new user should be able to register, clear KYC and receive a loan decision in a single session. • If approved, money reaches the linked bank account immediately, and the repayment schedule appears in-app. • Failed KYC or low score blocks disbursal and shows an explanatory message. • EMIs collected automatically on the due date, with status reflected in the app dashboard. If you have shipped similar fintech or lending products in Flutter, show me. I’m ready to move quickly once I can see you understand these integrations.

opportunities.title: 10-Minute YouTube Edit
opportunities.description: I have a bundle of mixed footage—talking-head clips, B-roll, and the occasional screen grab—waiting to be shaped into a polished, 10-minute YouTube video. The final cut needs to feel clean and professional rather than hyper-energised, so smooth pacing, tidy transitions, and restrained on-screen text are key. Here’s what I’m counting on you to handle: • Trim and reorganise the raw clips so the story flows naturally and never drags. • Add background music and light sound-effects that complement the content without overpowering it. • Drop in basic text call-outs or lower thirds where context is needed. • Apply consistent colour correction and grade so every shot matches. • Balance dialogue, music, and ambient audio so viewers aren’t riding the volume knob. You’re welcome to work in either Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, but you should already be fluent in whichever you choose. I’ll share the raw files as soon as we agree, and I’ll need the finished render (plus the project file) back within three days. When you reply, include links to past work that best demonstrates clean, professional edits—no lengthy proposals required. If your portfolio proves you can deliver this standard on a tight timeline, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Digital Marketing and sales for saas product
opportunities.description: My SaaS platform is already attracting interest, but free users are not converting fast enough. The single, measurable objective is to turn more of those trials into paid subscribers. To do this, I want a focused campaign built around WhatsApp marketing combined with an irresistible, well-structured sales pitch. Target audience • Small business owners—typically time-poor, budget-conscious, and needing simple, instant value. Every message, creative, and offer must speak directly to their pain points and show how upgrading delivers an immediate payoff. Scope of work 1. Map the conversion journey: audit our existing sign-up flow, identify friction, and decide exactly where WhatsApp touchpoints will make the biggest impact. 2. Craft the sales narrative: concise copy and compelling CTAs that feel helpful rather than pushy, formatted for WhatsApp’s short-form style. 3. Build and automate: set up WhatsApp Business API (or approved third-party tool) with contact segmentation, trigger messages, and tracking links feeding into our CRM. 4. Launch a pilot: run A/B tests on message timing, offer structure, and length of free-trial window, iterating quickly on performance data. 5. Handover: provide campaign assets, funnel diagram, KPI dashboard template, and a playbook my team can replicate for future cohorts. Acceptance criteria • 10-day pilot produces statistically valid uplift in trial-to-paid conversion (baseline data available). • All assets delivered in editable format (Google Docs + CSV contact flows). • Clear next-step recommendations supported by metrics. If you have hands-on experience with WhatsApp Business API, conversion copywriting, and rapid funnel testing, this project is ready to start immediately.

opportunities.title: Consumer Product 3D CAD Modeling
opportunities.description: I have a new consumer-grade enclosure that needs to move from concept to the factory floor, and I’m looking for an experienced CAD designer who can turn my rough sketches and key dimensions into a fully detailed 3D model ready for machining. The design must be clean, accurate, and built with manufacturability in mind—proper draft angles, wall thicknesses, snap-fit or screw bosses where appropriate, and clear tolerances that a CNC shop can rely on. You’ll be working from reference photos, hand sketches, and a short feature list that I’ll share once we start. I’m happy to jump on a quick call to clarify intent, materials, or assembly requirements so you can hit the ground running. Deliverables • The native CAD file in your preferred software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor, or similar) • Neutral formats (.STEP and .IGES) for the machine shop • A simple dimensioned drawing or exploded view that highlights critical fits and fastener locations Once the model passes my fit-check review, I’ll release final approval so you can export the hand-off files. If you’ve taken similar products all the way to production before, that experience will be a big plus. I’m ready to get started right away—let’s build something great.

opportunities.title: Hiring: Organic Lead Generation & Sales Closing Expert (Commission-Based)
opportunities.description: I am looking for an experienced and results-driven Organic Lead Generation and Sales Closing Expert to help me find clients and close website design projects for my web design business. I specialize in designing professional, mobile-friendly WordPress websites for small businesses. I am looking for someone who can independently generate qualified leads using organic methods and convert those leads into paying clients. This is a commission-based opportunity, ideal for a freelancer who is confident in lead generation, client communication, follow-ups, negotiation, and closing sales. Responsibilities Find potential clients organically through Google Maps, Google Search, LinkedIn, business directories, and other relevant platforms. Identify small businesses that need a new website or improvements to their existing website. Contact business owners through personalized outreach, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, or other appropriate channels. Generate qualified leads and build relationships with potential clients. Handle follow-ups, client communication, sales discussions, and negotiations. Present our website design services and portfolio to potential clients. Convert interested prospects into paying website design clients. Coordinate with me regarding project requirements, pricing, and delivery. Ideal Candidate Proven experience in organic lead generation and B2B sales. Strong experience in selling website design or digital services. Ability to communicate professionally with international clients. Experience targeting businesses in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, or other international markets. Strong follow-up, negotiation, and sales-closing skills. Self-motivated, reliable, and focused on results. Commission & Payment 100% commission-based compensation. No fixed salary or upfront payment. Commission will be paid for successfully closed and paid website projects. Commission percentage, payment terms, and refund-related conditions will be mutually agreed upon before starting. Opportunity to build a long-term partnership with additional earning potential as sales grow. I am looking for someone interested in building a long-term business relationship rather than simply collecting leads. The main goal is to generate genuine opportunities and close paying clients. How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal: Your experience in organic lead generation and sales closing. Your experience selling website design or digital marketing services. The methods you use to find and contact potential clients. Which countries and business niches you have experience targeting. Your approach to converting leads into paying clients. Any previous results, case studies, or examples of successful deals, if available. Your expected commission percentage. Important: Please apply only if you are comfortable working on a commission-only basis and are confident in your ability to generate leads and close sales. I look forward to working with a motivated sales professional who can help grow this business together.

opportunities.title: Mobile UI/UX Cross-Device Tester
opportunities.description: I need a keen-eyed tester who can hop between iPhone and Android handsets and tell me exactly how my website look and feel on each screen size, orientation, and OS version. Your main objective is to stress-test the responsive design: text alignment, interactive elements, spacing, breakpoints, font rendering, colour consistency—anything that might throw off a real user on mobile. Here’s the flow I have in mind. I’ll share a staging link along with a short checklist of user journeys. You’ll browse, tap, swipe and rotate the device where relevant, recording observations as you go. When you spot an issue, capture it with a screenshot or quick screen-recording, note the device/OS/browser combo, and suggest a straightforward fix if you can. Deliverables (per test cycle) • A concise report outlining each visual or layout inconsistency, grouped by device and browser. • Annotated screenshots or short clips highlighting the exact element in question. • Confirmation once the same pages render correctly after revisions. I’m aiming for someone available a few hours each week, whenever new builds drop, so we keep regressions from creeping back in. If that cadence suits you and you’re comfortable juggling both iOS and Android toolchains—Safari/WebView, Chrome, Firefox, Samsung Internet, the usual suspects—I’d love to hear how you conduct mobile UI/UX reviews and keep them efficient.

Here’s the flow I have in mind. I’ll share a staging link along with a short checklist of user journeys. You’ll browse, tap, swipe and rotate the device where relevant, recording observations as you go. When you spot an issue, capture it with a screenshot or quick screen-recording, note the device/OS/browser combo, and suggest a straightforward fix if you can. Deliverables (per test cycle) • A concise report outlining each visual or layout inconsistency, grouped by device and browser. • Annotated screenshots or short clips highlighting the exact element in question. • Confirmation once the same pages render correctly after revisions. I’m aiming for someone available a few hours each week, whenever new builds drop, so we keep regressions from creeping back in. If that cadence suits you and you’re comfortable juggling both iOS and Android toolchains—Safari/WebView, Chrome, Firefox, Samsung Internet, the usual suspects—I’d love to hear how you conduct mobile UI/UX reviews and keep them efficient."

opportunities.title: SaaS Digital Marketing
opportunities.description: My SaaS platform is already attracting interest, but free users are not converting fast enough. The single, measurable objective is to turn more of those trials into paid subscribers. To do this, I want a focused campaign built around WhatsApp marketing combined with an irresistible, well-structured sales pitch. Target audience • Small business owners—typically time-poor, budget-conscious, and needing simple, instant value. Every message, creative, and offer must speak directly to their pain points and show how upgrading delivers an immediate payoff. Scope of work 1. Map the conversion journey: audit our existing sign-up flow, identify friction, and decide exactly where WhatsApp touchpoints will make the biggest impact. 2. Craft the sales narrative: concise copy and compelling CTAs that feel helpful rather than pushy, formatted for WhatsApp’s short-form style. 3. Build and automate: set up WhatsApp Business API (or approved third-party tool) with contact segmentation, trigger messages, and tracking links feeding into our CRM. 4. Launch a pilot: run A/B tests on message timing, offer structure, and length of free-trial window, iterating quickly on performance data. 5. Handover: provide campaign assets, funnel diagram, KPI dashboard template, and a playbook my team can replicate for future cohorts. Acceptance criteria • 10-day pilot produces statistically valid uplift in trial-to-paid conversion (baseline data available). • All assets delivered in editable format (Google Docs + CSV contact flows). • Clear next-step recommendations supported by metrics. If you have hands-on experience with WhatsApp Business API, conversion copywriting, and rapid funnel testing, this project is ready to start immediately.

opportunities.title: Solidwork Air Vent STL & Simulation
opportunities.description: I have a hand-sketched mechanical air-vent that must be turned into a clean 3D model and STL file, then checked with an airflow & pressure-drop simulation—all ready for delivery tomorrow. You will receive the scanned sketches as soon as we start; the geometry is fairly simple but the duct path contains a few subtle curves that must be respected. The job breaks down into two quick steps: • Convert the sketch into a watertight CAD model and export an error-free STL suitable for printing or CNC. • Run a CFD analysis focused specifically on airflow and pressure drop through the vent. Use any reputable tool you’re comfortable with—SolidWorks Flow, Ansys Fluent, SimScale, Fusion 360, etc.—as long as you can supply colored contour plots and the numeric pressure-drop value. I can provide vent dimensions and basic operating conditions (flow rate, temperature, inlet pressure) immediately after project kick-off so you have real data to drive the simulation. Deliverables by tomorrow: 1. Native CAD file + final STL 2. Brief PDF/slide report with screenshots, boundary conditions, mesh summary, and the airflow/pressure-drop results If anything is unclear, message me right away—turnaround time is tight.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40786013, publicado hace 11 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 600 - 1,500.

opportunities.title: Travel Business Portfolio Website
opportunities.description: I need a clean, mobile-friendly portfolio site for my travel and tourism company. The site’s core purpose is to present our trips and services in a visually compelling way that builds trust and inspires travellers to reach out. Content & structure Visitors must be able to browse a steady stream of travel tips, destination guides and genuine customer reviews. These articles will sit alongside striking imagery that highlights what makes each experience unique, giving the whole site the feel of an ever-growing showcase rather than a static brochure. Contact options Every page should make getting in touch effortless: a built-in contact form, a persistent WhatsApp chat button and clearly placed phone-and-email links. Key deliverables • Fully responsive portfolio-style website (WordPress, Webflow, Wix or a comparable CMS) • Blog / guide section with easy-to-update templates for tips and reviews • Integrated contact form connected to our business email • One-click WhatsApp chat button (web & mobile) • Click-to-call and mail-to links in header and footer • Basic on-page SEO and Google Analytics setup so we can track engagement Acceptance The project is complete once the live site matches the agreed mock-ups, all contact channels send through successfully, and I can add a new guide or review without touching code. If you have recent examples of visually rich travel or lifestyle sites, that will help me see how you would bring this portfolio vision to life.

opportunities.title: Diseño y maquetación de web corporativa en Wordpress con Elementor V4
opportunities.description: Somos QMS Calidad, una consultoría de certificación ISO en Madrid (calidad, medio ambiente, seguridad y salud en el trabajo). Queremos rehacer el diseño de nuestra web, qmscalidad.com , que hoy está en WordPress con el tema Astra y Elementor. Qué te damos hecho: El mapa de la web, con las páginas y el objetivo de cada una. Todos los textos, ya escritos y revisados. Las fotos seleccionadas. El logotipo y los colores de la casa. Qué necesitamos de ti: Una propuesta de diseño de la portada y de una página de servicio. Elegimos una y sobre esa sigues. La maquetación de unas 10 páginas en Elementor V4 (elementos atómicos, no los widgets clásicos), con estilos y colores globales, para que luego podamos cambiar los textos sin romper el diseño. Que se vea bien en el móvil y cargue rápido. Todo en borrador: la web actual sigue publicada hasta que aprobemos la nueva. Condiciones: Trabajas con un usuario de WordPress que te creamos para el proyecto. No hace falta acceso al alojamiento. No usamos Elementor Pro. Si alguna parte lo necesita de verdad, dínoslo en tu propuesta y lo valoramos. No cambies plugins ni ajustes de la web sin preguntarnos antes. Si necesitas algún plugin nuevo, que sea compatible con PHP 8.4, que es la versión en la que irá la web. Pago por hitos: propuesta de diseño, maquetación completa y correcciones finales. En tu propuesta, cuéntanos: Dos o tres webs que hayas hecho con Elementor V4 (enlaces). Cuánto tardarías y tu precio por el proyecto completo. Cuántas rondas de correcciones incluye. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Cambio mediano

opportunities.title: Admin Chat Pelanggan Online
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk menangani chat pelanggan dan calon pembeli setiap hari. Fokus utamanya adalah menjawab pertanyaan seputar produk dan layanan kami secara cepat, ramah, dan akurat agar calon pelanggan mendapatkan informasi yang mereka perlukan. Tugas utama: • Memantau dan membalas chat pelanggan melalui kanal yang sudah kami sediakan (terutama marketplace dan WhatsApp Business). • Memberikan jawaban jelas tentang spesifikasi produk, harga, ketersediaan stok, serta prosedur pembelian. • Mencatat pertanyaan berulang agar kami dapat memperbarui FAQ. • Mengeskalasi isu teknis atau keluhan kompleks ke tim internal sesuai prosedur. Harapan hasil: • Waktu respons maksimal 5 menit saat jam operasional. • Nada bicara profesional, sopan, dan sesuai panduan brand. • Laporan ringkas di akhir hari berisi jumlah chat masuk, pertanyaan utama, dan tindak lanjut yang diperlukan. Pengalaman sebelumnya sebagai customer service online atau admin chat akan sangat membantu. Jika Anda terbiasa menggunakan fitur quick replies, tag, dan label di WhatsApp Business atau platform serupa, sebutkan di proposal Anda.

opportunities.title: Editor/a Vídeo Dinámico Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Tengo grabaciones ya filmadas y busco a alguien que domine la edición para transformarlas en piezas de unos 5 minutos, ágiles y visualmente potentes, pensadas específicamente para Instagram y TikTok. Trabajo en castellano, así que necesito que te comuniques fluidamente en español y sepas adaptar tono, ritmo y tendencia a una audiencia hispanohablante. No me importa qué software uses (Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, etc.); lo esencial es que el resultado final sea atractivo y mantenga a la audiencia enganchada. Entregables principales: • Video final optimizado para formato vertical 9:16, listo para publicar en Instagram Reels y TikTok. • Versión sin marcas de agua ni logotipos ajenos. • Archivo fuente o proyecto editable para ajustes futuros. Para evaluar compatibilidad, empezaríamos con un primer video. Si quedo satisfecho, habrá encargos regulares. Incluye en tu propuesta enlaces directos a trabajos similares o tu portfolio online. ¡Nos vemos en la bandeja de entrada!

opportunities.title: Edición creativa de vídeos sociales
opportunities.description: Grabaré piezas de unos cinco minutos hablando directamente a cámara y necesito que tú las transformes en clips capaces de captar la atención en Instagram, TikTok y otras redes. Busco un estilo rápido y enérgico: cortes ágiles, efectos llamativos y un ritmo que mantenga la vista pegada a la pantalla. Para reforzar el impacto, quiero incorporar: • Palabras destacadas y subtítulos que se muevan con la voz • Música y efectos de sonido que marquen el tempo • Transiciones fluidas y algunos apoyos visuales (imágenes o pequeños inserts) cuando el discurso lo pida Yo entregaré el metraje crudo y cualquier indicación clave sobre tono o mensaje. Tú devuelves un archivo optimizado para vertical (1080 × 1920) listo para publicar, color corregido, con audio balanceado y todos los elementos sincronizados. El primer encargo será un único vídeo; si encajamos, la idea es seguir colaborando de forma continua. Trabaja desde donde quieras. Envíame enlaces a dos o tres de tus mejores ediciones que muestren ritmo, creatividad y buena narrativa visual.

Busco un estilo rápido y enérgico: cortes ágiles, efectos llamativos y un ritmo que mantenga la vista pegada a la pantalla. Para reforzar el impacto, quiero incorporar: • Palabras destacadas y subtítulos que se muevan con la voz • Música y efectos de sonido que marquen el tempo • Transiciones fluidas y algunos apoyos visuales (imágenes o pequeños inserts) cuando el discurso lo pida Yo entregaré el metraje crudo y cualquier indicación clave sobre tono o mensaje. Tú devuelves un archivo optimizado para vertical (1080 × 1920) listo para publicar, color corregido, con audio balanceado y todos los elementos sincronizados. El primer encargo será un único vídeo; si encajamos, la idea es seguir colaborando de forma continua. Trabaja desde donde quieras. Envíame enlaces a dos o tres de tus mejores ediciones que muestren ritmo, creatividad y buena narrativa visual."

opportunities.title: Logotipo elegante para marca
opportunities.description: Necesito un logotipo elegante y profesional para una tienda / marca de productos. Quiero que combine el nombre de la marca con un símbolo o icono que refuerce la identidad visual y comunique confianza y calidad. Lo que busco • Estilo: Elegante y profesional, sin recargar detalles innecesarios. • Formato: Nombre de la marca acompañado de un símbolo o icono distintivo. • Versatilidad: El diseño debe funcionar igual de bien en etiquetas, empaques, web y redes sociales, tanto en color como en versión monocromática. • Originalidad: Solo se aceptarán propuestas 100 % originales; nada de plantillas genéricas. Entregables • Archivos vectoriales editables (AI o SVG). • Versiones en PNG y JPG a 300 dpi. • Breve guía de uso que indique tipografías y paleta de colores. Valoraré detalles como la armonía tipográfica, la legibilidad a distintos tamaños y la capacidad del icono para reconocerse incluso sin el texto. ¡Espero ver tu mejor concepto!

opportunities.title: Editor de Videos con Ia para Producción Mensual de 20 Videos de Alt...
opportunities.description: ¡Hola! Estamos buscando una persona creativa que nos ayude a producir videos de alta calidad utilizando inteligencia artificial. La idea es construir una relación de trabajo a largo plazo, con una producción constante de 20 videos mensuales de aproximadamente 10 minutos cada uno. No nos importa si tienes 1, 5 o 10 años de experiencia. Lo que más nos importa es la calidad de tu trabajo y lo que seas capaz de crear. Queremos ver resultados, creatividad y dominio de las herramientas. ¿Qué necesitamos? Experiencia creando videos completamente con IA. Manejo de ElevenLabs y/o herramientas que permitan mantener un personaje consistente entre escenas. Capacidad para trabajar con diferentes estilos: cinematográfico, animado, documental, entre otros. Buen criterio visual, narrativa audiovisual y edición. Capacidad para mantener una calidad constante en una producción de 20 videos al mes. Importante: no buscamos videos hechos con imágenes estáticas, presentaciones de diapositivas ni recopilaciones de videos de stock o material de libre uso. Las escenas deben generarse con IA y tener movimiento, coherencia visual y una calidad que mantenga al espectador interesado. ¿Qué te entregaremos? Para cada video recibirás el guion, la voz en off, el perfil y las referencias del personaje, el estilo visual deseado y las instrucciones necesarias para producirlo. ¿Qué esperamos recibir? Un video completamente terminado, editado y listo para publicar en YouTube, con todas las escenas, animaciones, transiciones, música y efectos necesarios según el estilo solicitado. No buscamos clips sueltos ni trabajos a medio terminar. El contenido debe ser original y estar preparado para cumplir las políticas de monetización de YouTube, aunque la aprobación final depende de la plataforma. Presupuesto y propuesta Queremos comparar diferentes propuestas y encontrar la mejor relación entre calidad y precio. Cuéntanos: ¿Cuánto cobras por un video terminado de aproximadamente 10 minutos? ¿Cuál sería tu precio por los 20 videos mensuales? ¿Qué herramientas utilizas para generar los videos y mantener la consistencia del personaje? ¿Puedes compartir ejemplos de tus mejores trabajos? La calidad será nuestro principal criterio de selección, por encima de los años de experiencia o de los títulos que tengas. Buscamos a alguien que disfrute creando contenido, proponga buenas ideas y quiera crecer con nosotros en un proyecto de largo plazo. Una última cosa Si llegaste hasta aquí, escribe historia al inicio de tu propuesta y comparte tu portafolio con ejemplos de videos creados con ia. ¡Queremos ver de qué eres capaz! Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Crear o editar video ¿Qué necesitas?: Video y grabaciones nuevos

opportunities.title: Diseño CAD de Silla Salvaescaleras
opportunities.description: Se solicita un profesional con experiencia en ingeniería mecánica, estructural y diseño CAD para desarrollar el diseño de una silla salvaescaleras de concepto original, destinada a viviendas unifamiliares o multifamiliares, con una carga nominal objetivo de 160 kg. El diseño deberá priorizar la seguridad, ergonomía, funcionalidad, estética moderna y modularidad, permitiendo futuras modificaciones y adaptación a diferentes configuraciones de escaleras. Entregables: Modelo 3D del conjunto y componentes. Planos generales y detalles técnicos. Especificaciones preliminares de materiales, uniones y tolerancias. Propuesta de rieles, soportes y sistema de fijación. Lista de materiales y componentes comerciales. Esquema funcional del accionamiento y controles. Criterios preliminares de cálculo y seguridad. Identificación de riesgos y plan de pruebas. Guía básica de montaje y mantenimiento. Estimación de costes de fabricación. Formatos: PDF y archivos CAD editables, preferentemente STEP y DWG, según corresponda.

opportunities.description: Busco un asistente remoto que atienda principalmente llamadas entrantes con el objetivo de agendar citas para mi centro de belleza y estética. Necesito una voz amable, organizada y capaz de transmitir confianza a cada cliente desde el primer “hola”. La colaboración iniciará de forma remota y puede convertirse en un acuerdo a largo plazo si encajamos bien. Espero tu propuesta.

opportunities.title: Reconstrucción y Mejora de Plataforma Cloud de Impresión, Copia y E...
opportunities.description: Se busca un desarrollador experimentado o un equipo de desarrollo para la reconstrucción y mejora integral de una plataforma cloud existente, especializada en servicios de impresión, copia y escaneo. Este proyecto de gran envergadura incluye la modernización y optimización de las aplicaciones móviles para iOS y Android, así como la interfaz web de la plataforma. El objetivo principal es garantizar una experiencia de usuario fluida, un rendimiento robusto y una funcionalidad avanzada en todas las plataformas. Se requiere profunda experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles nativas, desarrollo web full-stack, integración con servicios en la nube (cloud computing) y diseño e implementación de APIs robustas. El equipo seleccionado será responsable de analizar la arquitectura actual, proponer soluciones innovadoras y ejecutar el desarrollo completo para entregar una plataforma optimizada y preparada para el futuro. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Cambio mediano
